You have not looking at your sons and you have told them the sages They are brilliant and mighty, not fear of flame.
And in the fire they have been wrapped in your presence in my presence Pratishrutam tatha cheti jvalanena mahatmana

verse_sans_lines: तथाग्नौ ते परीत्ताश्च त्वया हि मम संनिधौ

verse_translation.google_trans: The guardian of the world is a liar, not a speaker in any way They are able and the speakers are not in them.

verse_sans_lines: लोकपालोऽनृतां वाचं न तु वक्ता कथंचन
समर्थास्ते च वक्तारो न ते तेष्वस्ति मानसम्

verse_translation.google_trans: But you are suffering from thinking of my friend. I have no affection for me as it happened in her before

verse_sans_lines: ध्रुवं मयि न ते स्नेहो यथा तस्यां पुराभवत्

verse_translation.google_trans: For it is not justified to be familiar with affectionate friends Somehow the soul can see the oppressed.

verse_sans_lines: न हि पक्षवता न्याय्यं निःस्नेहेन सुहृज्जने

verse_translation.google_trans: Go to the old woman for which you are suffering I will walk alone as in the case of a coward
I do not do so in the world so that you are convinced of you I wandered about for the sake of children and that was in trouble
He who relies on the future in the future, forsakes the past, the slow-witted. Do as you please the world insulting him

verse_sans_lines: अवमन्येत तं लोको यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु

verse_translation.google_trans: This is the flaming fire of the Lalelihans. For the hateful causes me to suffer in my heart, for I am untimely.

verse_sans_lines: द्वेष्यं हि हृदि संतापं जनयत्यशिवं मम

verse_translation.google_trans: Then, in the flame that passed from the country, then it was burnt. He went to the sons of his sons, hurrying to his son.
She is the source of all the well-wishing fires. She saw her sons in the forest, crying and miserable.
The most unbelievable is the sight of them again and again And one by one, he cried out to those sons.

verse_sans_lines: अश्रद्धेयतमं तेषां दर्शनं सा पुनः पुनः

verse_translation.google_trans: Then he approached the slow-moving man with a sudden state of India Then all the sons did not rejoice in him

verse_sans_lines: अथ ते सर्व एवैनं नाभ्यनन्दन्त वै सुताः

verse_translation.google_trans: Each one by one and the old man again and again They did not say anything to the sage, whether it was good or bad.
The eldest son is what and what is your next Who is the middle son and who is the youngest?

verse_sans_lines: मध्यमः कतमः पुत्रः कनिष्ठः कतमश्च ते

verse_translation.google_trans: Why don't you answer me who are suffering from saying this I have done it in Havya and I cannot find peace

verse_sans_lines: एवं ब्रुवन्तं दुःखार्तं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे

verse_translation.google_trans: What are your eldest daughters, or by the latter? And what about your middle work in the youngest ascetic

verse_sans_lines: किं ते ज्येष्ठे सुते कार्यं किमनन्तरजेन वा
किं च ते मध्यमे कार्यं किं कनिष्ठे तपस्विनि

verse_translation.google_trans: Who you have left me in every way without me and have gone in the past Go to that very beautiful woman with a beautiful smile.

verse_sans_lines: यस्त्वं मां सर्वशो हीनामुत्सृज्यासि गतः पुरा

verse_translation.google_trans: There is nothing else than a man other than women For that should be in the world without a wife.
Suvratapi hi kalyani sarvalokaparishruta Arundhati, the best of the sages, the best of the sages.
Pure feelings are extremely always engaged in the welfare of the beloved In the midst of the seven sages, the hero insulted the sage

I have come for the sake of children so are you here Leaving the desired itself, she behaves in the same way

verse_sans_lines: इष्टमेवंगते हित्वा सा तथैव च वर्तसे

verse_translation.google_trans: A man should believe that he is not a wife in any way For the wife does not meditate on the work, the son of Sati.

verse_sans_lines: नैव भार्येति विश्वासः कार्यः पुंसा कथंचन
न हि कार्यमनुध्याति भार्या पुत्रवती सती

verse_translation.google_trans: Then all of them were properly worshiped by their sons And he began to comfort them, O king.
I have told you to protect you And so it was so promised by the fire and so on.
Knowing the words of Agni and your mother’s religion, you are And yours are beyond your prowess, I have not come here before.

verse_sans_lines: युष्माकं च परं वीर्यं नाहं पूर्वमिहागतः

verse_translation.google_trans: For you should not be afflicted, my son, for death The sages know the sages, and even the Brahman is known to you.

verse_sans_lines: न संतापो हि वः कार्यः पुत्रका मरणं प्रति
ऋषीन्वेद हुताशोऽपि ब्रह्म तद्विदितं च वः

verse_translation.google_trans: Thus comforting his sons and his wife, India Mandpala then went to another country from the country

verse_sans_lines: ग्रहीतुं तच्च शक्रोऽस्य तदा कालं चकार ह

verse_translation.google_trans: When the Lord will be pleased with the great god I will then give you the Pandavas weapons in all respects
And I will know that time, O son of the Kurus. I will give them to you with great austerities

verse_sans_lines: अहमेव च तं कालं वेत्स्यामि कुरुनन्दन
तपसा महता चापि दास्यामि तव तान्यहम्

verse_translation.google_trans: and all the southwests and the winds as well And you will take all my things, Dhananjaya

verse_sans_lines: आग्नेयानि च सर्वाणि वायव्यानि तथैव च

verse_translation.google_trans: Vasudeva also took the love of Partha eternally Then the lord of the gods gave him that boon and pleased him

verse_sans_lines: ददौ च तस्मै देवेन्द्रस्तं वरं प्रीतिमांस्तदा

verse_translation.google_trans: Giving them a boon, pleased with the gods, Marutpati Fire permission and went to the heavens again

verse_sans_lines: दत्त्वा ताभ्यां वरं प्रीतः सह देवैर्मरुत्पतिः

verse_translation.google_trans: The fire also burned the woods and the deer and the bird He stopped five days and was satisfied

verse_sans_lines: अहानि पञ्च चैकं च विरराम सुतर्पितः

verse_translation.google_trans: They ate the flesh and the fats and blood. Yukta, with supreme love, said to them, Lord of the worlds

verse_sans_lines: जग्ध्वा मांसानि पीत्वा च मेदांसि रुधिराणि च
युक्तः परमया प्रीत्या तावुवाच विशां पते

verse_translation.google_trans: I am satisfied with you both men and foremost men I allow you to walk the heroes where you want

verse_sans_lines: अनुजानामि वां वीरौ चरतं यत्र वाञ्छितम्

verse_translation.google_trans: Thus they were permitted by the great Pavaka Mahatma Arjuna, Vasudeva and Maya and Maya
